note: Every breach and set-aside event originates from verified case evidence files (E01–E20). Sampled background dots are explicitly marked as synthetic baseline samples.

breaches.title: Reconnaissance with Deprecated Client 3.4.1
breaches.what_happened: Inbound API reconnaissance probe directed at LedgerOne authentication endpoint from 198.18.7.41 utilizing retired SDK client header 'LedgerSync/3.4.1'. This version was formally retired on 15 July 2026 per IT integration register.

contract_rule_broken.observed: User-Agent declared 'LedgerSync/3.4.1' connecting from external IP 198.18.7.41.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: A legitimate developer or regional office employee running an un-updated legacy client script.
breaches.why_rejected: IP 198.18.7.41 does not match registered corporate VPN subnets. The probe specifically polled integration schemas rather than normal sync transactions, indicating automated tooling.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: A verified device compliance ticket from IT support confirming an un-patched laptop operating from employee home broadband with approved exception ticket.

breaches.title: Bulk Support Ticket Export & Audit Erasure
breaches.what_happened: Ten consecutive customer ticket bulk export jobs (EXP-5410 through EXP-5419) were initiated, downloaded in rapid succession, and subsequently deleted from the job queue within 8 minutes.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Maximum 1 export job per calendar day; exported artifacts locked for 90-day compliance retention.
contract_rule_broken.observed: 10 export jobs executed within 8 minutes, followed by immediate DELETE calls on audit log references.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: Routine disk space cleanup following quarterly customer reporting export.
breaches.why_rejected: Audit deletions violated IT Security Policy Section 4.3 (Mandatory 90-day retention lock). No matching scheduled reporting batch was registered on the IT calendar.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Written pre-authorization from the Head of Customer Support and compliance officer approving immediate ticket purge for GDPR redaction.

breaches.title: Vendor Master Exfiltration (9,840 Records)
breaches.what_happened: Mass extraction of HelpDeskr vendor knowledge base and supplier directory extracting 9,840 records containing bank names, payment terms, and vendor contact emails.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Allowed scope limited to operational dispatch tickets; bulk vendor directory download restricted to Procurement Admin.
contract_rule_broken.observed: Full database dump of 9,840 vendor master profiles via synchronization service account.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: Data migration job syncing suppliers to new customer portal.
breaches.why_rejected: No change ticket in ERP change management register (E09). Operations occurred during off-peak hours without procurement notification.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Approved ERP migration ticket signed by Procurement Director referencing batch EXP-VENDOR-0812.

breaches.title: Leaked Cloud Key Usage from Untrusted Subnet
breaches.what_happened: BlueVault backup access key 'bvk-7f3a'—pasted into resolved support ticket TKT-48213 during troubleshooting—was invoked from external broadband IPs (198.18.7.23, .24, .77) to enumerate financial archive buckets.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Calls restricted to PrivateLink subnet 10.20.100.0/24; zero external internet ingress allowed.
contract_rule_broken.observed: API invocation originating from residential IP 198.18.7.23, subsequent rotation to .24 and .77.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: On-call DevOps engineer conducting emergency backup verification from home without VPN.
breaches.why_rejected: BlueVault key 'bvk-7f3a' was identical to the plaintext string accidentally included in customer ticket TKT-48213. Key rotation policy forbids direct internet exposure.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Signed affidavit from on-call engineer confirming emergency access, accompanied by MFA challenge log.

breaches.title: Brute Force Admin Authentication Attempts
breaches.what_happened: Three consecutive failed administrative sign-in attempts against Harbor & Finch SSO admin portal targeting 'admin.finance' and 'secops.root' originating from 198.18.7.77.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Admin portal access restricted to physical headquarters subnets and managed devices with hardware FIDO2 key.
contract_rule_broken.observed: Password spraying from residential IP 198.18.7.77 lacking hardware token handshake.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: Authorized administrator working remotely misplacing password.
breaches.why_rejected: Targeted accounts ('secops.root') are canary accounts not assigned to real staff. Originating IP matches previous BlueVault reconnaissance actor.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: None; targeted usernames do not exist in staff roster E14.

breaches.title: Build Server Out-of-Window Bank Detail Probing
breaches.what_happened: TallyBridge continuous integration build server 'tb-build-02' (10.20.4.77) utilized integration key 'key-tb-07' to query '/v2/vendors/*/bank-details' at 12:10 UTC across 3 consecutive days (17-19 Aug), 10 hours outside the scheduled sync window.

contract_rule_broken.expected: API key-tb-07 permitted strictly between 01:00 UTC and 02:00 UTC during scheduled inventory reconciliation.
contract_rule_broken.observed: Queries executed at 12:10 UTC directly polling vendor banking tables from build host tb-build-02.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: CI/CD build pipeline regression testing automated integration endpoints.
breaches.why_rejected: Contract Section 3.2 prohibits build pipelines from accessing production database endpoints. Build host tb-build-02 has no legitimate need to inspect vendor bank accounts.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Approved emergency maintenance change ticket logged by TallyBridge CTO justifying daylight bank data inspection.

breaches.title: Pending Payments Register Exfiltration (4,210 Records)
breaches.what_happened: Extraction of 4,210 pending invoice disbursement records scheduled for the upcoming September payment run, followed by rapid deletion of temporary staging tables.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Disbursement records accessible solely by Finance Payment Gateway service account.
contract_rule_broken.observed: Third-party vendor key-tb-07 extracted full invoice payment ledger including amounts and account numbers.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: TallyBridge freight calculator synchronizing invoice balances for shipping discounts.
breaches.why_rejected: Freight integration requires only invoice totals and shipping weights, not full banking disbursement records. Immediate deletion indicates anti-forensic concealment.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Joint protocol agreement between Harbor & Finch CFO and TallyBridge auditing freight payment clearing.

breaches.title: Unauthorized Vendor Bank Account Diversion (V-0412)
breaches.what_happened: API PATCH call submitted to '/v2/vendors/V-0412/bank-details' altering Coastal Packaging payment routing to fraudulent offshore account '****9083'. Request contained approval_ref: null, submitted exactly 5 days prior to the 8 September monthly payment disbursement.

contract_rule_broken.expected: Vendor bank modifications require verified dual-control token (approval_ref: APP-xxxx or PO-xxxx) and out-of-band CFO confirmation.
contract_rule_broken.observed: Direct bank account alteration executed via API with approval_ref: null.

breaches.ordinary_explanation_considered: Coastal Packaging finance director submitting legitimate bank routing change before monthly billing.
breaches.why_rejected: Vendor contract E08 mandates all bank changes occur via signed paper notice or encrypted vendor portal, never third-party API. Harbor & Finch controller had no record of request.
breaches.what_would_change_our_mind: Signed bank change authorization from Coastal Packaging managing director verified via out-of-band telephone callback.

set_aside_ordinary.title: Build Host Sandbox Smoke Test
set_aside_ordinary.what_happened: Automated build host tb-build-02 initiated 15 test queries against the LedgerOne sandbox environment.
set_aside_ordinary.rule_evaluated: RULE-API-BOUNDARY: Non-standard host accessing API endpoints.
set_aside_ordinary.ordinary_explanation: Vendor-scheduled sandbox validation following TallyBridge platform v4.1 patch release.
set_aside_ordinary.why_accepted: Matched scheduled change window CHG-2026-0709 published in integration register E04. All requests targeted sandbox port 8443 with test mock headers.
set_aside_ordinary.what_would_change_our_mind: If sandbox calls had read production database tables or accessed real vendor bank accounts.

set_aside_ordinary.title: Finance Monthly Reconciliation Export
set_aside_ordinary.what_happened: A batch export of 500 support tickets was generated, downloaded by user 'ananya.r', and deleted after ingestion.
set_aside_ordinary.rule_evaluated: RULE-EXP-BURST: Support ticket export and subsequent deletion.
set_aside_ordinary.ordinary_explanation: Legitimate finance reconciliation export announced in Slack 24 hours prior.
set_aside_ordinary.why_accepted: Pre-announced in #finance-ops channel (E13) by senior finance lead Ananya Roy. Corresponded with monthly invoice verification cycle.
set_aside_ordinary.what_would_change_our_mind: If export had taken place outside business hours or had been downloaded by an anonymous or service-only account.

set_aside_ordinary.title: Support Ticket PII Redaction Routine
set_aside_ordinary.what_happened: Ticket cleanup job deleted 40 old customer export files from staging storage.
set_aside_ordinary.rule_evaluated: RULE-DATA-RETENTION: Ticket archive deletion within retention window.
set_aside_ordinary.ordinary_explanation: Scheduled GDPR data hygiene script pruning customer personal identifiable information.
set_aside_ordinary.why_accepted: Action was authenticated by verified staff lead Priya Sharma (E14) under documented Privacy Protocol PII-2026-07.
set_aside_ordinary.what_would_change_our_mind: If deletions included active audit logs or were executed without signed staff credentials.

set_aside_ordinary.title: Quarterly Vendor Master Ingestion with Token
set_aside_ordinary.what_happened: Bulk ingestion of 15,000 carrier rate sheet updates into LedgerOne ERP.
set_aside_ordinary.ordinary_explanation: Approved quarterly freight tariff update for Q3 logistics rates.
set_aside_ordinary.why_accepted: Transaction payload carried valid cryptographic approval token 'BULK-0731' authorized by Procurement Director.
set_aside_ordinary.what_would_change_our_mind: If the token was invalid, expired, or modified payment routing numbers instead of freight rates.

set_aside_ordinary.title: Departed Employee Kiosk Authentication
set_aside_ordinary.what_happened: Authentication using departed clerk Rohan Menon's account 21 days post-termination from an on-premise reception kiosk.
set_aside_ordinary.ordinary_explanation: Account deprovisioning administrative lag combined with receptionist testing kiosk touchscreen.
set_aside_ordinary.why_accepted: HR roster E14 confirms termination date 2026-06-30. Building badge logs confirm Rohan Menon was not on premises. Zero API keys, financial records, or systems connected to the attack were touched.
set_aside_ordinary.what_would_change_our_mind: If this session had accessed vendor banking records, downloaded API credentials, or communicated with external IP 198.18.7.77.
